description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultMetadataHeaderKey class, which implements the MetadataHeaderKey interface. It provides methods for parsing, validating, and comparing metadata header keys based on JSON pointers, including handling wildcards and path comparisons.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaderKey
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetadataHeaderKey, representing a metadata header key with parsing, validation, and comparison logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence to create a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer, with validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the JsonPointer path for correct structure and wildcard placement.

methods.name: appliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Checks if the path applies to all leaves (wildcard at root).

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the relevant JsonPointer path, handling wildcards.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this key with another for ordering, considering wildcards.
